highlights: CNC: multi-bit jobs continue past their bit changes, a capped spindle scales its feeds, a spindle at 0 RPM refuses to send the job, tabs keep their width, and Job Review adds a depth guide and a low chip-load warning.
CNC reliefs step down by the stock still standing under the tip, tiled jobs keep registration bores clear of parts and board edges, and recovery keeps Work Z across an Abort.
Imports keep their true shape: DXF splines, arcs, circles and ellipses, GeoJSON holes, and DXF and STL numbers read whole. PostScript imports have a time limit, and Latin text kerns as the font says.
Design tools leave variable text and the registration jig alone. Re-trace keeps its placement, Offset Shapes and Kerf name what they drop, and Convert to Path keeps curves as curves.
Image Studio filters preview in the background with Cancel, a new Photo Test Card finds a photo's power and speed, and image masks keep the Fill region and real edge pixels.

Cameras: a network camera's calibration follows it to another computer, timelapses ride out hiccups and wait until saved, and live pictures are rechecked for moves. JCZ galvo lasers connect over USB (experimental).
